definition.title: MSE append-window clipping [report paragraph label]
definition.source_excerpt: R118: append-window filtering accepted all source bytes but retained only coded frames in the requested window. The final range was approximately [1.066666,2.899999]. This is useful for in-browser trimming, but it does not save transport bytes: Chrome still receives/parses the supplied media.
